author: Mindstellar
description_html:
Storefront

The default Shopclass theme for classifieds sites. It has a card-grid layout, three colour palettes, light and dark schemes, and plain JavaScript with no jQuery.

Requirements

  • Shopclass 7.0.0 or later. Sites on an older core stay on Storefront 1.3.x.
  • PHP 8.0 or later
  • No plugins needed.

Install

Shopclass bundles Storefront and activates it on a fresh install. To install it yourself:

  1. Go to Appearance → Manage themes.
  2. Find Storefront in Browse, or upload storefront_X.Y.Z.zip from the releases.
  3. Click Install, then Activate.

Set up

  1. Go to Appearance → Storefront: Brand:
    • Site name: the wordmark shown when no logo is set.
    • Logo: SVG, PNG or JPG. An SVG is cleaned on upload and follows the text colour, so one file works in light and dark. PNG and JPG are saved to oc-content/uploads/.
    • Compact logo (optional): a small mark for phones. The main logo shows if it is empty.
  2. Go to Appearance → Storefront: Settings:
    • Colour palette: Teal, Indigo or Violet.
    • Colour scheme: Light, Dark or Auto (follow device).
    • Home / Hero: Headline and Tagline, plus switches for the decorative graphic, the popular-category chips and the featured listings row.
    • Search & Location: Post & edit form location (autocomplete or dropdowns), Search page location (country, region and city; region and city; or autocomplete), Search box placeholder and Default results view (gallery or list).
    • Footer & Social: Footer tagline, links for Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn, and the "Powered by Shopclass" credit.
  3. Press Save. An empty text field restores its default.

Features

  • Every palette and scheme pair meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast.
  • Right-to-left locales switch the layout by themselves.
  • Featured listings on the home page, related listings and custom fields on the item page.
  • Widget zones: header, footer and item_sidebar.
  • Core draws the account, sign-in, profile, contact and credits pages inside Storefront's header and footer. The theme styles them through hooks in inc/core-pages.php.

Customising

Settings are stored as theme preferences, so they survive updates. For deeper changes, edit the design tokens at the top of css/storefront.css (--color-*, --font-*, --space-*, --radius-*, --shadow-*) or use a child theme.

For developers

  • Hooks fired:

    | Hook | Where | |---|---| | header, footer | End of <head>, before </body> | | before-main, after-main | Around the main content | | search_ads_listing_top | Top of home and search results | | search_ads_listing_medium | Every 6 search results | | home_before_featured, home_after_featured | Around the featured row | | home_before_listings, home_after_listings | Around the latest-listings row | | item_meta, item_detail | Item page body | | item_before_related, item_after_related | Around the related row | | item_sidebar | Item page aside | | item_contact_form | Inside the seller contact form |

  • css/ and js/ run as they are. npm install then npm run build writes the *.min.* files and compiles languages/*/theme.mo. Both are gitignored.
  • Strings use the text domain storefront. Run npm run i18n to update languages/storefront.pot and languages/en_US/theme.po.
  • To work on the theme, clone it and symlink it into oc-content/themes/storefront.
  • A vX.Y.Z tag runs .github/workflows/release.yml, which builds and publishes storefront_X.Y.Z.zip.

Support

Report problems at github.com/mindstellar/theme-storefront/issues.

License

GPL-3.0-or-later. Copyright Navjot Tomer (Mindstellar) and contributors.

versions.changelog_html:
First public release of Storefront — the default public theme for Shopclass: a modern, responsive, vanilla-JS (no jQuery) classifieds front end.

Highlights

Admin settings backend

Two pages under Appearance let operators rebrand and retune the front end without touching code (all options are stored as theme preferences and survive theme updates):

  • Brand & Logo — site-name wordmark; logo upload accepting SVG, PNG or JPG. SVGs are sanitized on upload (scripts and remote references stripped) and inlined so they follow the text colour — correct in both light and dark mode. Optional compact logo for small screens.
  • Settings — colour palette, colour scheme, home hero, search & location behaviour, footer & social, and more (below).

Design & accessibility

  • Three selectable colour palettes — Teal (default), Indigo, Violet — on a warm-sand ground with deep-navy ink.
  • Light, dark or auto colour scheme (auto follows each visitor's device).
  • Every palette × mode combination meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast — including accent text in dark mode.
  • Automatic RTL from the visitor's locale, via logical CSS properties.
  • Photo-forward card grid, sticky search, accessible mobile navigation.

Search & location

  • Search-page location as Country + Region + City, Region + City (for single-country sites), or type-ahead autocomplete.
  • Post/edit form location as autocomplete or cascading dropdowns.
  • Location autocomplete built on core's shared combobox — no jQuery.

Home & content

  • Configurable hero headline & tagline; toggles for the decorative graphic, popular-category chips, and the featured (promoted) listings row.
  • Featured listings, related listings, custom fields, and widget zones (header, footer, item_sidebar).

Performance

  • JS split per surface and loaded only where used; all scripts deferred.
  • Minified assets ship in the release; stateless, cache-safe rendering.

Install

Storefront ships bundled with Shopclass 6.0.0+ and is activated on a fresh install. To install manually, unzip storefront_1.0.0.zip into oc-content/themes/ and activate it under Settings → Appearance.

Full documentation: see the README.
